A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Finer-CAM work. All 15 pages of each version, including equations, tables, figures, references, and appendices, are readable and support comparison after matching relocated content.

before.justification: v1 reports original quantitative evaluations on five fine-grained datasets, method ablations, and qualitative saliency-map experiments in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original quantitative evaluations, ablations, and qualitative experiments, including the supplementary CLIP and DINOv2 results.

M1.justification: The gradient-based and score-based logit comparisons, aggregation before ReLU, reference selection, and multimodal extension remain unchanged. The average-pooling clarification in Section 3.2 does not establish a changed algorithm or architecture.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Birds-525, CUB-200, Cars, Aircraft, and FishVista, and retain the same classification explanations and multimodal concept-localization scenarios. The newly named pretraining source documents the existing CLIP setup.

E2.justification: Grad-CAM, Layer-CAM, and Score-CAM remain the quantitative comparators. The qualitative comparisons retain RISE, Mask, direct CAM subtraction, and GEM. The GEM comparison moves from Figure 12 to Figure 11 without changing comparator membership.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, 100-epoch Adam training with learning rate 3e-4, comparison strength 0.6, top-three aggregation, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged. Naming the OpenCLIP variant adds previously unspecified information without reporting a revised experimental protocol.

E4.justification: Reference-selection, comparison-strength, aggregation, consistency, extrapolation, reverse-comparison, and failure-case analyses are retained. The aggregation ablation moves from Section 4.3 and Table 3 to Appendix B.4 and Table 7. The failure examples are reordered, not newly added.

E5.justification: Figure 1 retains its existing shaded variability bands. Appendix A.1 corrects 'standard variation' to 'standard deviation' as terminology; no changed statistical procedure, repeated-run information, confidence interval, or significance test is reported.

E6.justification: Matched numerical tables, plotted findings, and qualitative examples remain unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains Birds-525 RD.@0.05 values of 0.174 for Grad-CAM and 0.192 for its Finer variant. The aggregation results also remain identical after relocation to Table 7.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(12), including the logit-difference derivation and relative-drop definition, remain unchanged. The average-pooling parenthesis near Equation (4) clarifies the existing explanation without introducing a substantive revision to the mathematical argument.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about discriminative localization through class comparison, CAM compatibility and efficiency, adjustable comparison strength, multimodal applicability, and relative-confidence-drop advantages.

C2.justification: v1 already discusses failures associated with incorrect classifier predictions in Appendix C.5. v2 retains this discussion in C.1 and adds that Finer-CAM may degenerate to baseline methods when logit similarity does not reflect visual similarity, particularly when the target class differs substantially from others.

D1.justification: Appendix B.1 newly specifies OpenCLIP ViT-B-16 pretrained on LAION-400M, whereas v1 identifies only a pretrained CLIP backbone. This adds useful reproducibility information about the existing setup. The code and demo access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, cited works, and positioning relative to earlier explanation methods remain unchanged. Reference-list differences concern page pointers following the supplementary reorganization.

P1.justification: v2 makes limited wording corrections, changes 'Multi-model' to 'Multi-modal' in Section 3.3, and adds supplementary pointers. It moves the aggregation discussion to Appendix B.4 and reorders Appendix C, while retaining most prose verbatim.

P2.justification: The aggregation table moves to the supplement, and existing appendix figures are reordered and renumbered. v2 also adds an x-axis label to Figure 5's lower deletion plot, clarifies Table 2's caption, and introduces a supplementary title and separate pagination. The underlying visual examples are retained.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves reproducibility by identifying the CLIP variant and pretraining source, and improves qualification of the method through the added similarity-related limitation. Clearer figure and table labeling also helps readers. These are useful refinements, while the method and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
